_about: Art directions elan deals from in build, explore and brand. Each entry has enough to render a hero option on the decision page. For a full build brief, fetch `source.prompt` (curl -sL <url>): stack, exact tokens, numbered sections and the pitfalls the author hit. instalanding.ai entries are MIT (Ray Velez); fonts are Google Fonts unless noted. Palettes are hex taken from the source; entries marked `palette_note` describe colours the source gives in words or oklch. Add your own favourites at the end with source.kind = 'own'.
_dealing: Deal 3-4 entries that differ in theme (light/dark), type genre (serif / grotesk / display / pixel / stencil / blackletter), and imagery method. Add one 'category standard' option. Never deal two from the same family.

directions.name: Risograph print
directions.thesis: A two-ink print on warm paper: halftone art drawn in code, hard offset shadows, tight huge grotesk.
directions.imagery: Seeded SVG (wafer maps, orbits, charts, reactors) printed through a CSS halftone screen; paper grain mask
directions.motion: Print-shop physics: plates slide into register, shadows collapse on hover, stamps land with back-out overshoot
directions.signature: A cover that scrubs apart on scroll: masthead letters fly outward, the sunburst arch scales up

directions.name: Dot-matrix clinical
directions.thesis: Ink and paper sections alternating like a service report; a dot-matrix wordmark and live monitor traces.
directions.imagery: Inline SVG devices and monitor traces; 7% fractal-noise grain on dark sections
directions.motion: Precise and procedural: rows pulse on a staggered loop, checklists tick, numbers settle
directions.signature: The wordmark drawn as 5x7 pill grids that split apart; a pinned 12-check inspection board

directions.name: Chrome and stone
directions.thesis: Black and brushed metal: an extruded logo on a rough pedestal in a CSS 3D scene, nothing else in colour.

type.display: system UI, headline second line filled with a metal gradient

directions.imagery: CSS 3D extrusions and SVG morphs; no images, no web fonts
directions.motion: Heavy and deliberate: spring-morphs between shapes, slow rotation, metal sheen on hover
directions.signature: A metal logo that spring-morphs between three shapes as the hero tabs change

directions.name: Pixel arcade
directions.thesis: A launch page where the hero is the playable game: pixel type, dithered skies, a console frame with lamps.
directions.imagery: Canvas 2D sprites, starfields, dithered gradient bands
directions.motion: Frame-stepped: blinking pixels, steps() easing, screen-shake on impact
directions.signature: A one-button game playable in the hero

directions.name: Machined hardware
directions.thesis: Bead-blasted alloy: a device built in CSS 3D where every dial, fader and key works, in three finishes.
directions.imagery: Layered DOM in CSS 3D; a diagonal light shaft over soft grey
directions.motion: Tactile: keys depress with a click, faders drag with friction, needles settle
directions.signature: A full controller you can play, with audible clicks and a finish switcher

directions.name: Machine front panel
directions.thesis: The page is the machine: anodised plates, copper screws, amber lamps, and it boots itself on load.
directions.palette_note: Lamp and readout colours from the matching 'kiln' design system.
directions.imagery: CSS and inline SVG screws, blades, gauges and LEDs
directions.motion: Boot sequence: an amber flash, a lamp flicker that catches then latches, a needle self-test
directions.signature: The panel boots 560ms after load, then hands the switches to you

directions.name: Neo-brutalist stencil
directions.thesis: Loud and warm: huge stencil type over op-art rings, 3px ink outlines, hard shadows that press flat on click.

type.body: IBM Plex Sans Condensed (italic for accent lines)

directions.imagery: Op-art concentric ring patterns; glossy SVG characters whose eyes follow the pointer
directions.motion: Punchy: shadows press flat on click, marquees run, characters track the cursor
directions.signature: Animoji characters whose eyes follow the pointer
best_for: anything that should feel human and loud

directions.name: Illuminated manuscript
directions.thesis: A science product set like a manuscript: blackletter headings lit by a shader, hand-drawn margins.
directions.imagery: One WebGL shader lighting the headings; spinning conic frame borders; hand-drawn SVG
directions.motion: Slow and reverent: light passes across gilding, borders turn, ink draws in
directions.signature: Blackletter headings lit by a moving WebGL light
best_for: anything that should feel old and careful

directions.name: Manga issue
directions.thesis: Strictly two inks: a black-and-white manga issue with screentone, shouted lettering and a sliced retro sun.
directions.imagery: Inline SVG with SMIL animation; CSS screentone; a hand-drawn line via feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap
directions.motion: Comic timing: speed lines, panel slams, impact frames, a typing terminal
directions.signature: The whole page as one bordered panel on a halftone desk, panels slamming in

directions.name: Sunset story
directions.thesis: The first 6000px are a story: the sun sets over a layered landscape, night falls, then the page arrives.
directions.palette_note: Sky is a radial gradient over white shifting through sunset to night; see the source prompt.
directions.imagery: One fixed inline SVG landscape (viewBox 750x500, xMidYMax slice); canvas for the product
directions.motion: Cinematic and slow: layered parallax hills, a sky that changes with scroll, stars appearing
directions.signature: Scroll sets the sun; the page only begins after nightfall

directions.name: Stage light
directions.thesis: A product reveal under theatre lights: conic spotlights, rising dust, a drafting frame, a lit mountain ridge.
directions.palette_note: Colours given as conic-gradient beams; see the source prompt.
directions.imagery: CSS conic spotlights and a dust canvas; the stage scales as one object from a single --size
directions.motion: Theatrical: beams sweep, dust rises, a light sweep runs through the wordmark
directions.signature: A light sweep through the wordmark as the spotlights find it

directions.name: Highlighter paper
directions.thesis: Quiet editorial paper where every highlight is a real rough-edged highlighter with a meaning per colour.
directions.palette_note: Highlighter colours from the matching 'footnote' design system.
directions.imagery: Paper grain and highlighter texture as inline SVG data URIs
directions.motion: Restrained: highlights sweep across words, notes open in place
directions.signature: A marked-up answer where every highlighted claim opens its source

directions.name: Y2K messenger
directions.thesis: Your old instant-messenger buddy: glossy titlebars, bevelled buttons, a violet-to-magenta brand gradient.
directions.imagery: Window chrome in CSS; a spotlight that follows the pointer
directions.motion: Nostalgic UI: windows nudge and shake, buddy-list sounds, sheen across gradient pills
directions.signature: A working chat window that nudges you and runs tasks

directions.name: Generative fashion editorial
directions.thesis: A fashion-magazine layout: one giant word, handwritten margin notes, every image a gooey generative composition.
directions.imagery: Gooey generative SVG compositions in six colours
directions.motion: Editorial: compositions morph slowly, notes write themselves in
directions.signature: A hero word at 22vw with hand-written annotations pinned around it

directions.name: Warm premium store
directions.thesis: Cream and glass: a calm premium shop where every product tile is generated, behind a search bar that types itself.
directions.imagery: Seeded generative SVG product modules; glassmorphism
directions.motion: Calm and smooth: a sphere of tiles turns slowly, glass catches light
directions.signature: A spinning sphere of product tiles behind a glass search bar that types its own query

directions.name: Clay and glass
directions.thesis: A big-tech storefront in warm clay and frosted glass with a live LED dot-matrix display.
directions.imagery: CSS and SVG devices; four clay shadow recipes
directions.motion: Soft and friendly: clay presses in, LED dots scroll, a toggle rewrites the page
directions.signature: A live LED metro map as the hero

directions.name: Night sea
directions.thesis: Navy depth over a live WebGL sea that ebbs on scroll into the product itself.
directions.imagery: A WebGL water shader; navy cards with hairline rings
directions.motion: Tidal: slow swells, the sea pulls back to reveal UI
directions.signature: The sea ebbs on scroll into a terminal, then a clickable workspace

directions.name: Paper-cut dusk
directions.thesis: Night navy with a paper-cut sunset panel you can slap stickers on; spectrum-gradient second lines.
directions.palette_note: Source writes all colour in oklch.
directions.imagery: Inline SVG paper-cut layers, twinkling stars
directions.motion: Playful: stickers slap on, a dusk-to-daybreak arc, fat pill buttons that press down
directions.signature: A paper-cut sunset you decorate with stickers

directions.name: Toon diorama
directions.thesis: A cosy low-poly three.js world in the hero that the visitor can play, under bloom and tilt-shift.
directions.imagery: three.js scene generated in code (no models or textures); toon shading, bloom, tilt-shift
directions.motion: Bouncy and alive: characters dance, petals fall, the camera drifts
directions.signature: You take the controls of the hero world without leaving the page

directions.name: Swiss prism
directions.thesis: Swiss monochrome with one prism gradient refracted by a glass torus knot through giant uppercase type.
directions.imagery: A fixed three.js glass knot refracting the type; hairlines; numbered labels (01)
directions.motion: Exact: cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1) everywhere, ink panels wipe up on hover, titles nudge
directions.signature: Giant type seen through a refracting glass knot

directions.name: Pulp magazine
directions.thesis: A 1940s pulp detective magazine: mustard and blood red, flat illustration, shouted headlines.
directions.imagery: Flat silhouette illustration, halftone, evidence tags and stamps
directions.motion: Stamps and slaps: quick, physical, short overshoot
directions.signature: Evidence stamped onto the page

source.note: elan bake-off, impeccable run on noir-casefile (2026-10-22); palette approximate

directions.name: Dark cinema
directions.thesis: Film grain and a single warm spotlight; a serif headline resolving out of darkness.
directions.imagery: Grain, spotlight gradients, letterbox framing
directions.motion: Slow fades and drifts; nothing snaps
directions.signature: A headline that resolves out of darkness with one word in red italic
